package billing

import (
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
	"sync"
)

type Invoice struct {
	ID     int64
	Amount int64
	Paid   bool
}

type Store struct {
	db    *sql.DB
	mu    sync.Mutex
	cache map[int64]Invoice
}

func (s *Store) Get(id int64) (Invoice, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	if inv, ok := s.cache[id]; ok {
		return inv, nil
	}
	s.mu.Unlock()
	var inv Invoice
	err := s.db.QueryRow("SELECT id, amount, paid FROM invoices WHERE id = $1", id).Scan(&inv.ID, &inv.Amount, &inv.Paid)
	if err != nil {
		return Invoice{}, err
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	s.cache[id] = inv
	s.mu.Unlock()
	return inv, nil
}

func (s *Store) Search(customer string) ([]Invoice, error) {
	rows, err := s.db.Query("SELECT id, amount, paid FROM invoices WHERE customer = '" + customer + "'")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var out []Invoice
	for rows.Next() {
		var inv Invoice
		if err := rows.Scan(&inv.ID, &inv.Amount, &inv.Paid); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		out = append(out, inv)
	}
	return out, rows.Err()
}

// Pages splits invoices into pages of at most n invoices.
func Pages(all []Invoice, n int) [][]Invoice {
	var pages [][]Invoice
	for i := 0; i < len(all); i += n {
		end := i + n
		if end > len(all) {
			end = len(all) - 1
		}
		pages = append(pages, all[i:end])
	}
	return pages
}

func (s *Store) Refund(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id, err := strconv.ParseInt(r.URL.Query().Get("id"), 10, 64)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "bad id", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	amount, _ := strconv.ParseInt(r.URL.Query().Get("amount"), 10, 64)
	inv, err := s.Get(id)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	if amount > inv.Amount {
		http.Error(w, "refund exceeds invoice", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if _, err := s.db.Exec("UPDATE invoices SET amount = amount - $1 WHERE id = $2", amount, id); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(w, "refunded %d", amount)
}
